tasks.title: Capture authentic Japanese first-bomb Start/normal Project64 traces
tasks.summary: Original-MIPS controlled first-bomb microtrace supports a conditional Start→pause scheduler mask→17 fade checks→VM cursor reset→checkpoint-13 suppression, but its bomb actor and renderer were synthetic. A prepared read-only Project64 3.x Japanese v0 kit records genuine normal/Start traces; Node mock recorder tests and nine Python comparator tests passed, but no real PJ64 execution or savewarp was observed.
requires: Windows Project64 3.x debugger with Always use interpreter core and original Japan revision-0 ROM (header CRC1 832C168B / CRC2 56A2CDAE)
one genuine first Gourmet Sub bomb pre-dialogue savestate with checkpoint not 13; exact same savestate for normal and one-frame Start trial
manual user Start input when physically available, plus actual observed save/reload warp outcome

source-only local kit Goemon_Bomb_Text_Skip_Project64_Trace_Kit_2026-11-21.zip (SHA-256 0de4a714b96cbf6158596e236ac72b4033e50653f95180a58ffc6a87e7f3e933); scripts are NOT committed because of original-game script command signatures
tasks.next_step: When local Windows/PJ64 access returns, load the genuine first-bomb savestate before starting each read-only recorder. Capture normal Goemon_Bomb_JP_normal.jsonl (no Start) and Start trial Goemon_Bomb_JP_start.jsonl (manual one-update Start) from the exact same state. Stop via GOEMON_BOMB_STOP() to record end. Run compare_bomb_traces.py --normal ... --start ... --report ... --markdown ...; capture actual VM task +0x22 flags, g_system+0x3AE24, cursor, fade queries 1–17, checkpoint-13 store/write and eventual saved warp. Preserve raw traces/savestate locally; publish only sanitized report and hashes. Instructions: decomp/tasks/bomb_text_skip_live_trace/README.md.
tasks.acceptance: Two authentic, complete, same-savestate original-JP Project64 interpreter JSONL captures; verified ROM header; original checkpoint13 command reached in normal and Start cases; actual scheduler mask +0x22 captured; complete PC-ordered Start, pending command, fade, cursor reset and checkpoint writes; real observed warp outcome separately documented. Comparator must return a justified outcome or INCONCLUSIVE/REFUTED. Synthetic traces and lack of write alone are never proof.
